verdict.rationale: Follow Up Boss is a CRM with a public REST API, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair thing to ask about. Nothing in the evidence documents a sandbox, a test account, or a dry-run mode that keeps work away from production data. The free trial is a sales offer, not a documented developer sandbox, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
